newsitem.title: UK: Novorossiisk pipeline to shut next week - trade.
newsitem.headline: Novorossiisk pipeline to shut next week - trade.

text.p: The crude pipeline feeding Russia's main oil export terminal at Novorossiisk on the Black Sea will close for maintenance work next week, traders and shipping sources said.
"It was due to close on February 20th but was put back to the 25th to allow the remaining February cargoes to load," said a trader.
"Nothing has been officially confirmed yet but we should know by Monday," said a shipping source.
The 650,000 barrels per day (bpd) port shut during the early hours of Thursday morning because of high winds and swell and was likely to remain closed for a couple of days, the shipping source said.
Novorossiisk has been closed for much of the past week because of bad weather, leading to loading delays of up to seven days and a lengthening queue of vessels outside the port.
Eight crude tankers were at anchor on Thursday waiting to berth.
The pipeline feeding the port was shut for six days for repairs in December, reopening on Christmas Eve.
